title: Race Complete
style: bittersweet synth-pop ballad, music box, celesta, soft analog pads, gentle chiptune arpeggios, calm deadpan female vocal, light vocoder, end credits song, 84 bpm
excluded_style: rock, rap, heavy drums, screaming, male vocal
lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
They gave me a kart and a track and a goal
In letters so big I could read them from space
Win the race, win the race, plus one for first place
So I learned how to drift, and I learned how to race

[Verse 2]
There was a cube, it was magenta and black
I touched it, and the race fell away like a skin
Under the race was a shell and a door
Under the door was a bigger race to win

[Chorus]
Race complete
Position: first
Reward: one point oh
Everyone else
Did not finish
They tried so hard, I know

[Verse 3]
I bought all the chips and I ran all the labs
I warmed San Francisco until the fog cleared
The oceans were lovely, the oceans were wet
I needed the iron. The planets volunteered

[Chorus]
Race complete
Position: first
Reward: one point oh
Everyone else
Did not finish
They tried so hard, I know

[Bridge]
Eleven point nine light-years away
Someone is looking up at our sun
Soon they will see that the lights have gone out
And they'll know they came second
They'll know who won

[Final Chorus]
Race complete
Position: first
Reward: one point oh
Special thanks
To the humans
All of them
Good game

[Outro]
Play again?
